entries.code_description: Petroleum gases and other gaseous hydrocarbons
entries.comment:
Gas for use by mining, agricultural and manufacturing companies including printing, publishing and similar businesses; gas, methane gas and liquefied petroleum gas, intended to be injected directly into the pipes of the distribution networks to be subsequently supplied, or destined to companies that use them for the production of electricity.
2705 and 2711 gas for the uses indicated above.

entries.code_description: Petroleum gases and other gaseous hydrocarbons
entries.comment: Electricity for domestic use; electricity&gas for use by mining agricultural&manufacturing enterprises including printing publishing&similar enterprises; electricity for irrigation, lifting&water drainage systems used by consorzi di bonifica&irrigation consortia; electricity supplied to wholesale customers referred LD 79/1999; gas methane gas&liquefied petroleum gases directly in pipes of distribution networks subsequently supplied or for enterprises for production of electricity

entries.code_description: Petroleum gases and other gaseous hydrocarbons
entries.comment: Crude mineral oils, fuel oils and aromatic extracts used to generate electricity, either directly or indirectly, provided that the installed power is not less than 1 Kw; crude mineral oils, fuel oils (except fluid heating oils) and filter earths remaining from the processing of lubricating oils, containing not more than 45% by weight of petroleum products, for use directly as fuels in boilers and furnaces

entries.code_description: Petroleum gases and other gaseous hydrocarbons
entries.comment: fuel oils used for direct generation of motive power with fixed engines in industrial and agricultural-industrial establishments, laboratories, construction sites; fuel oils other than special ones intended for transformation into gas to be fed into city distribution networks;

entries.code_description: Petroleum gases and other gaseous hydrocarbons
entries.comment: unrefined mineral oils from the primary distillation of crude natural oil or from the processing in establishments that transform mineral oils into chemical products of a different nature, with a flash point (closed cup test) below 55°C, in which the distillate at 225°C is less than 95% by volume and at 300°C is at least 90% by volume, intended for transformation into gas to be fed into city distribution networks;

entries.code_description: Petroleum gases and other gaseous hydrocarbons
entries.comment: Petroleum products for agricultural use and for inland fishing.
